snippet_draft: For most Ontario basements the best flooring is rigid-core luxury vinyl plank (SPC or WPC): it is waterproof-rated, sits happily on concrete, and shrugs off the humidity swings a below-grade room goes through every year. Laminate can work in a dry basement with the right underlay, while solid hardwood and most carpet should stay upstairs.
